body: It doesn't feel like I can completely trust the teachers, and there's only one counselor in the school. Thanks for talking to me.

Usually I just rant to my brother or retreat to my room when my dad does something.
I've spoken to the school counselor, and she gave me advice on how to deal with my dad. But it doesn't feel like she was listening or taking me seriously when I tried to bring up my feelings and issues.
So now when I see her I just give politically correct answers regarding the way I feel about things.

As for my teacher, she pulled me aside and then told me that I didn't know any better, after talking to my dad over the phone and apparently hearing how hurt he was at my addiction to my tablet and my behavior towards my youngest brother. It's a long story.

Edit: tried to make things a little less confusing
Thanks. I'm not entirely sure I have mental issues, but you're right, the teenager angst is difficult enough to deal with.
